column3: tomato puree (total soluble solids not less than 9.0 percent) and tomato paste (not less than 25 percent) are the two named products. Codex CXS 57-1981 Processed Tomato Concentrates likewise designates tomato puree and tomato paste as tomato concentrate (https://www.fao.org/input/download/standards/237/CXS_057e.pdf). Recognition routing only: the tomato concentrate row's placement (Brazil Dietary Guidelines Group 3 clause for tomato extract or concentrates with salt and/or sugar) and its rule apply unchanged: Group 3 only when salt or sugar is stated and nothing else is listed or bracketed
